content.comment_body: Hello. I'm developing a website using [product_name] [version_no] that will run on AWS. I want to display a table that shows daily updated data from an analog variable. How can I achieve this? Is it possible to add a chart that also refreshes automatically? Regards.

Hi, storing data in AWS and performing historical analysis isn't supported directly by [product_name]. If you have experience with AWS development, you can implement this functionality there. Hope this clarifies.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to show and update a table and chart with daily analog variable data using [product_name] [version_no] on a website hosted with AWS. Responses highlight that direct storage and historical data analysis within [product_name] is not available, suggesting that users handle these features using AWS programming instead. This points to limitations in built-in options for storing and visualizing historical data.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to easily create and display automatically updated tables and charts with historical analog variable data directly within [product_name] [version_no] for their AWS-hosted website.
